hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.command" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)git[[:space:]]+(add[[:space:]]+(-A|--all|-u|\.)([[:space:]]|$)|commit[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*a|--all))" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"The git index is shared with any concurrent Claude Code session in this repo, and bulk staging has already swept another session's unfinished work into a commit once. Stage explicit paths, then: git commit --only -F <msgfile> -- <paths>\"}}" || true

jq -r ".tool_input.command" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)git[[:space:]]+(clean[[:space:]]+[^|]*-[a-zA-Z]*f|reset[[:space:]]+[^|]*--hard|checkout[[:space:]]+(\.|--[[:space:]]+\.))" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"This discards uncommitted work in the whole tree. Another session may have work in progress here. Confirm nothing else is mid-flight first.\"}}" || true
echo "[continuity] Context is about to be compacted. Save durable state to HANDOFF.md (goal, current state, files touched, failed approaches, next steps) before it is lost." >&2
